twitch_playback.https_required: Use HTTPS for both the dashboard and API before connecting a Twitch session. HTTP is allowed only on this computer (localhost).
twitch_playback.title: Twitch downloads
twitch_playback.description: Connect a Twitch website session to let the recorder request streams with that account’s access.
twitch_playback.shared_hint: This account is used for all manual and scheduled recordings on this server. Recordings remain available to everyone with library access. Only the server owner can manage this connection.
twitch_playback.reconnect_hint: Reconnect with a fresh Twitch session, or disconnect to record anonymously. A rejected session stops new playback requests.
twitch_playback.how_to: Where to find your Twitch session
twitch_playback.step_login: Open twitch.tv and sign in to the account you want to use.
twitch_playback.step_devtools: Open Developer Tools (F12). In Chrome, choose Application → Cookies → https://www.twitch.tv. In Firefox or Zen, choose Storage → Cookies → https://www.twitch.tv.
twitch_playback.step_cookie: Find the cookie named auth-token and copy only its value. Paste it below. Do not copy all cookies or run scripts in the console.
twitch_playback.token_hint: The value is hidden, stored encrypted, and never shown again. The field clears when you submit. Twitch Connect tokens do not work here.
twitch_playback.consent: I trust this server to store my Twitch session and use it for all recordings. This credential can grant account access beyond playback.
twitch_playback.quality_hint: Choose Up to 1440p or No limit in your recording or schedule. Twitch must offer that quality to the connected account. 1440p may require HEVC; Force H.264 can reduce the available quality.
twitch_playback.quality_session_missing: Twitch may only offer qualities above 1080p to a signed-in account. No Twitch session is connected, so this recording may fall back to a lower quality.
twitch_playback.quality_session_reconnect: Twitch may only offer qualities above 1080p to a signed-in account. The connected Twitch session needs to be reconnected, so this recording may fall back to a lower quality.
twitch_playback.quality_session_viewer: Twitch may only offer qualities above 1080p to a signed-in account. The server owner manages the Twitch session used for recordings.
twitch_playback.disconnect_success: Saved Twitch session removed. Future playback requests will use anonymous access. This does not sign the account out of Twitch.
twitch_playback.failed: Could not update the connection. Try again.
twitch_playback.load_failed: Could not load the Twitch playback connection.

auth.error_not_whitelisted: Your Twitch account is not authorized to use this app.
auth.error_access_denied: You declined the authorization. Please try again.
auth.error_invalid_state: Login session expired. Please try again.
auth.error_invalid_pkce: Login session expired. Please try again.
auth.error_invite_invalid: This invite link is invalid, expired, or already used.
auth.error_invite_self: This is your own invite link. Share it with the person you want to invite.

invites.title: Invites
invites.description: Create time-limited invite links to onboard new users with a chosen role. Each link can be used once; share it privately.
invites.url_ready: Copy this link now. It won't be shown again.
invites.failed_to_rotate: Failed to create a new link

invite.title: You've been invited
invite.subtitle: Sign in with Twitch to join this ReplayVOD server.

common.page_load_retry: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact your server administrator.

categories.title: Categories
categories.empty: No categories yet. Categories will be populated as streams are recorded.

channels.title: Channels
channels.empty: No channels yet. Channels will appear here as you follow broadcasters or configure download schedules.
channels.empty_live: No channels are live right now.
channels.empty_downloaded: No channels have downloaded videos yet.

errors.not_found_description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

videos.title: Videos
videos.empty: No videos yet. Trigger a download from a channel page.
videos.empty_continue_watching: No videos to continue. Start watching a video to see it here.
videos.no_match: No videos match the current filters.
videos.no_match_loaded: No matches in loaded videos yet. More results are loading.

download.description: Record now, or auto-record when they go live.
download.checking_live: Checking whether this channel is live…
download.live_check_failed: Could not check whether this channel is live. Try again.
download.offline_hint: direct download records a live stream only
download.offline_schedule_prompt: Want it recorded automatically next time?
download.schedule_intro: Automatically record this channel every time it goes live.
download.renditions_no_match: No available quality fits your selection. Choose a quality to continue.
download.renditions_hint: What Twitch offers for this stream right now. The recording takes exactly the one you pick.
download.renditions_anonymous_owner: Listed without a signed-in account. Connect a Twitch session to see whether higher qualities are available.
download.renditions_anonymous_viewer: Listed without a signed-in account. The server owner can connect a Twitch session to unlock more.

videos.quality_limit_hint: Records the highest quality Twitch offers within this limit.
videos.force_h264: Force H.264 (for older devices / broader playback compatibility)
videos.force_h264_tooltip: When a channel offers HEVC, check this to download H.264 instead. HEVC gives smaller files; some devices and browsers can't play it.

history.heading: Stream timeline
history.description: Title and category changes captured during this recording, interleaved chronologically.
history.empty: No title or category history recorded. Enable title tracking in config.toml to capture mid-stream changes.

completion.partial_tooltip: This recording is missing data — the download was interrupted and the Twitch CDN rolled past the gap before we could resume, or the run failed mid-recording with only some parts saved.
completion.truncated_tooltip: Recorder ended before the broadcast did — a server interruption, an unresumable run, or a finalize that never saw the playlist's end marker. The file itself plays cleanly; the broadcast just continued past where we stopped.
completion.cancelled_tooltip: You stopped this recording manually while the broadcast was still live.

videos.remove_confirm_body: This permanently deletes the recording's files. It stays in History as removed.
videos.remove_permanent_confirm_body: The files are already gone. This deletes the leftover previews and part metadata, so the recording can no longer be restored. It stays in History as removed.

watch.related_waiting: Waiting for the streamer to return
watch.not_ready: This video is not ready to play (status: {{status}}).
watch.removed: This recording has been removed and its files are no longer available.
watch.removed_missing: This recording's files are no longer in storage, so it was removed from the library.
watch.media_gone_title: This file is no longer in storage.
watch.media_gone_body: The recording's media was deleted or moved outside ReplayVOD. Remove it to clean up its history entry, or retry if storage is back.
watch.media_removed_body: Its files are no longer available.
watch.media_failed_body: The media could not be loaded. Check your connection and retry.
watch.switch_to_aside: Move history to the side of the player
watch.switch_to_wide: Move history below to make the player full-width
watch.removed_missing_actions: Put the files back and restore it, or remove it for good.

schedules.title: Auto-download schedules
schedules.description: When a channel goes live, matching schedules automatically start a download.
schedules.empty: Create a schedule to automatically record a channel when it goes live.
schedules.empty_viewer: Request a channel and an admin will set up its recording schedule.
schedules.quality_limit_hint: Records the highest quality Twitch offers within this limit.
schedules.force_h264_tooltip: When a channel offers HEVC, check this to download H.264 instead. HEVC gives smaller files; some devices and browsers can't play it.
schedules.is_delete_rediff: Delete the video if the VOD is kept after the stream
schedules.is_delete_rediff_hint: Number of hours after the stream ends before the VOD is deleted
schedules.no_categories: Type at least 2 characters to search Twitch categories.
schedules.no_tags: No tags yet — they populate as streams go live.
schedules.paused_banner_body: No recordings will start automatically until you resume. Each schedule keeps its own enabled state.
schedules.filters_coming_soon_hint: Stream signals aren't captured yet; these filters will be enabled in a later phase.

tasks.title: Scheduled tasks
tasks.description: Background jobs the scheduler runs on an interval.
tasks.unavailable: Unavailable in the current server configuration.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Every session currently signed into this account. Revoke any that don't belong to a device you recognize.

whitelist.title: Whitelist
whitelist.description: When whitelist is enabled in the server config, only Twitch user IDs listed here can sign in.
whitelist.validation_numeric: Must be a numeric Twitch user ID

requests.request_description: Ask for a channel to be auto-recorded. An admin reviews each request and sets up the schedule on approval.

history.title: Download history
history.media_missing_hint: The files left storage. Put all of them back to restore the recording.
history.empty_unavailable: No recording is waiting for its files.

events.title: Event logs
events.description: System-side events — task runs, downloads, auth outcomes.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: System events and outbound API calls in one place.

settings.playback_description: Choose when recordings resume and appear in Continue watching. These preferences follow your account across devices.
settings.resume_min_seconds_hint: Start from the beginning if your saved position is earlier than this.
settings.resume_end_margin_seconds_hint: Treat a recording as finished when this much time remains.
settings.resume_end_margin_percent_hint: For short recordings, limit the finish window to this percentage of their length.
settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Display preferences applied across the dashboard.
settings.timezone_hint: IANA name, e.g. Europe/Paris. Defaults to UTC.

eventsub.title: EventSub
eventsub.description: Twitch EventSub webhook subscriptions and cost/quota history.
eventsub.env_managed_hint: Environment variables are active for this server.
eventsub.restart_hint: Saved. Restart the server to apply this mode.
eventsub.nudge_setup: ReplayVOD can't see when your channels go live yet. Turn on live detection to show live status and start scheduled recordings automatically.
eventsub.nudge_restart: EventSub settings changed. Restart the server to apply them.
eventsub.choose_mode: How should ReplayVOD detect live channels?
eventsub.mode_direct_desc: Twitch calls your server directly. Needs a public HTTPS address.
eventsub.mode_relay_desc: Route events through a relay when your server has no public address.
eventsub.mode_poll_desc: No webhook. ReplayVOD checks Twitch on a timer. Simplest to run.
eventsub.mode_off_desc: Live detection stays off. Schedules won't start recordings on their own.
eventsub.direct_callback_hint: Add this as the callback URL in your Twitch app. ReplayVOD builds it from your server's public URL.
eventsub.direct_needs_public_url: Set your server's public URL to use direct mode.
eventsub.relay_url_hint: Paste the relay URL from your Connect account. ReplayVOD works out the rest.
eventsub.no_snapshot_yet: No snapshot yet — click Poll now to fetch current state.

webhook.title: Recording webhook
webhook.description: Fire a signed HTTP POST when a recording finishes or fails.
webhook.page_description: Send a signed event to your own endpoint whenever a recording reaches a terminal state — wire it to notifications, a media-server refresh, or post-processing.
webhook.url_hint: https for a public host; http is allowed for localhost or a private/LAN address. Link-local/metadata addresses are not allowed.
webhook.events_required: Pick at least one event, or disable the webhook.
webhook.secret_hint: Each delivery is signed HMAC-SHA256 over id + timestamp + body, sent in the Replayvod-Webhook-Signature header. Verify it with this secret.
webhook.rotate_confirm_body: The current secret stops working immediately. Any receiver verifying deliveries must be updated with the new secret, or its signature checks will fail.
webhook.deliveries_description: Durable delivery history with retry state. Failed and rejected deliveries can be queued again.
webhook.deliveries_empty: No deliveries yet. Send a test or wait for the next recording.

playback_cache.title: Playback cache
playback_cache.page_description: Generate copy-only playback files the first time a compatible multipart recording is played.
playback_cache.card_description: Ready files are used by the watch player; while one is building, parts still play normally.
playback_cache.max_percent_hint: Percent of the local storage filesystem reserved for generated playback files. Least-recently-used files are evicted over the limit.
playback_cache.save_failed: Failed to save playback cache settings
playback_cache.load_failed: Failed to load playback cache settings

archive.title: Archive VODs
archive.description: Download past broadcasts Twitch still has, so they stay in your library after Twitch removes them.
archive.links_hint: One VOD per line. Twitch keeps VODs for 14 to 60 days; anything older is already gone.
archive.links_invalid_one: {{count}} line is not a Twitch VOD link and will be skipped.
archive.links_invalid_other: {{count}} lines are not Twitch VOD links and will be skipped.
archive.links_too_many: Add at most {{max}} VODs at a time.
archive.result_invalid_hint: Paste a twitch.tv/videos link or a VOD id
archive.channel_failed: Could not load this channel's VODs
archive.channel_empty: This channel has no VODs on Twitch.
archive.select_all: Select every VOD not yet in the library
archive.queue_description: Archives download in the background, oldest first, without taking a live recording slot.
archive.remove_failed: Could not remove it from the queue
archive.failures_description: Archives that failed in the last 7 days. A passing failure is retried on its own; anything can be retried by hand.
archive.failures_empty: No failures in the last 7 days.

storage.title: Storage
storage.page_description: Where recordings live, and whether this server trusts it.
storage.card_description: The server records into, scans and plays from this location only while it carries this install's identity marker.
storage.storage_id_hint: Stored in the database and in the .replayvod-storage marker at the storage root. Keep the marker with the data.
storage.banner_unattached_body: Recording and scanning are paused, and recordings cannot play, until storage is mounted again or adopted.
storage.banner_full_body: Recordings play and can be deleted. Recording resumes when space is available.
storage.banner_read_only_body: Recordings play, but nothing records until storage accepts writes again.
storage.adopt_description: This claims {{location}} for this install by writing its identity marker. If it is an empty or different volume, the next scan removes every recording it does not hold from the library. Mount the original volume instead if this is a mistake.
storage.adopted_toast: Storage adopted. A scan has been scheduled.
storage.adopted_toast_no_scan: Storage adopted; automatic scanning is disabled.
storage.adopted_toast_scan_failed: Storage adopted, but the scan could not be scheduled. Try running it from Tasks.
storage.unreachable_hint: Mount the volume or fix the storage configuration. The server checks again every 30 seconds.
storage.attached_hint: Nothing to do. The scan keeps the library in step with what storage holds.
